name: The Crown Valley
description: Central pastoral kingdom; farms, markets, marriage houses, academies, public festivals, and royal bureaucracy. Best starting zone.

name: Mireglass Lowlands
description: Wetland of reflecting pools that preserve emotional memories. Main zones for herbalism, funeral rites, ghost ecology, and memory quests.

name: The Ash-Ring Marches
description: Borderlands around old volcanic ruins. Strong monster ecology, smithing resources, military orders, and expedition gameplay.

name: Saffron Coast
description: Trade ports, fishing guilds, shipwrights, migrant NPC cultures, culinary economy, piracy, and maritime festivals.

name: Highroot Canopy
description: Vertical forest settlements, druidic biotech, animal husbandry, rare woods, archery, and ecological governance.

name: The Quiet North
description: Snow provinces where time feels thin. High-level survival, ancestral spirits, archive temples, winter politics, and rare topogenic minerals.

name: The Subframe Labyrinth
description: Dynamic dungeon layer under all Hearthwells. Its rooms reconfigure according to unresolved social, ecological, and metaphysical pressures.
